svg.title: FOC and SVPWM signal chain derived from this STM32 firmware
svg.desc: A bilingual diagram separating current transforms, SVPWM compare trajectories, the center-aligned timer carrier, complementary gate pulses, and motor phase currents.
svg.text: From current vector to switching pulses / 从电流矢量到开关脉冲
A code-grounded reading of Clarke, Park, SVPWM_Calc(), TIM1 center-aligned mode, and CCR1-3
Adjacent-vector synthesis / 相邻矢量合成
Sector selection + Tx / Ty + symmetric zero-vector time
The code limits Tx + Ty, then shares the remaining time symmetrically.
Saddle-shaped compare trajectories / 马鞍形比较值轨迹
Normalized Tcmp1-3 while the αβ request rotates through one electrical cycle
compare / duty references, not phase current
Three waveform layers that must stay separate / 三层波形不能混为一谈
up/down counter behaves like a digital triangle / 计数器上下计数
one pair shown; three pairs make six outputs / 示意一组上下桥臂
continuous response after the inverter and motor / 电机侧连续响应
Firmware path SVPWM_Calc() → Tcmp1-3 → CCR1-3; TIM1 center-aligned mode forms the carrier.
The CPU does not store a triangle lookup array, and the saddle-shaped compare traces are not literal motor phase current.
